title: 우편환법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:30:0:00035:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 30 (Retention of Online Remittance Certificates)
(1) When submitting an online remittance request, the remitter may retain the online remittance certificate at the post office designated by the remitter and request payment when the recipient makes a payment request. (Amended July 31, 1998)
(2) The post office retaining the online remittance certificate in accordance with paragraph (1) must send the certificate back to the remitter within 7 days from the date the certificate is received if the recipient does not make a payment request. (Amended July 31, 1998)
